name: flow goals: a 20 mm block in slow water, the flow study page
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); part.variables = [{ name: 'H', expr: '20' }]; const { sketch } = itemsToSketch([{ kind: 'line', a: [0, 0], b: [20, 0] }, { kind: 'line', a: [20, 0], b: [20, 20] }, { kind: 'line', a: [20, 20], b: [0, 20] }, { kind: 'line', a: [0, 20], b: [0, 0] }]); const sk = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...sketch }); part.features.push(sk, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: sk.id, depth: 20 })); }); await sleep(1200); await m.run('flowStudy'); await sleep(300); const e = m.state.editing; Object.assign(e, { fluid: 'water', velocity: 0.0025, resolution: 8, flowMaxSteps: 0 }); return e.study; })()

name: flow goals: a global, a surface (front face) and a volume goal; stopped on settled goals; the goal table
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const e = m.state.editing; const g = m.sim2.goals; m.actions.pmSet('goal.addGlobal', 'vmax'); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const fi = faces.findIndex((f) => f.geomType === 'PLANE' && Math.abs(f.center.x) < 1e-6); e.pick = 'goalFaces'; g.pick(e, { index: fi }, faces[fi]); m.actions.pmSet('goal.surfKind', 'pAvg'); await m.actions.pmCommand('goal.addSurface'); await m.actions.pmCommand('goal.boxDefault'); m.actions.pmSet('goal.volKind', 'vMax'); await m.actions.pmCommand('goal.addVolume'); m.actions.pmToggle('goalStop', true); await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 400 && !e.result; i++) await sleep(150); await sleep(200); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.goal-table tr')].slice(1).map((tr) => tr.children[1].textContent); return JSON.stringify({ goals: e.goals.map((x) => x.kind + ':' + x.id), ok: e.result?.ok, conv: e.result?.converged, rows: rows.length, numbers: rows.every((x) => /\d/.test(x)) }); })()

name: flow goals: a parametric study over two inlet velocities — drag grows; a CSV of it
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const e = m.state.editing; m.actions.pmSet('goal.param', 'velocity'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('goal.from', '0.0015'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('goal.to', '0.0035'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('goal.steps', '2'); await m.actions.pmCommand('goal.runParam'); await sleep(200); const st = e.paramStudy; let csv = null; await m.actions.withExportSink(async (name, type, content) => { csv = content; return true; }, () => m.actions.pmCommand('goal.csv')); return JSON.stringify({ rows: st?.rows.length, grows: st.rows[1].goals[0] > st.rows[0].goals[0], restored: e.velocity === 0.0025, csv: String(csv).trim().split(String.fromCharCode(10)).length, table: document.querySelectorAll('.goal-table').length >= 2 }); })()
